title: incident-bot: prioritize on-call runbook quicklinks using SLO-weighted scoring
author: Aisha Kapoor
body: Context: on-call engineers rely on incident-bot quicklinks to surface relevant runbooks and diagnostics during paged incidents. Current quicklink ranking is largely keyword-based and surface-area limited which causes lower-priority runbooks to appear above high-impact playbooks for SLO-driven incidents. This change implements an SLO-weighted scoring layer that surfaces runbooks and automated diagnostics prioritized by affected SLO impact, recent incident frequency, and operator feedback score. Goals: 1) surface higher-impact runbooks first for incidents that touch critical SLOs; 2) provide an explicable scoring signal for audit and tuning; 3) avoid significant latency impacts to the quicklink response path. Description of changes: - new slo_toolkit.score.RunbookScorer computes a weighted score combining SLO impact, incident frequency (30d), and runbook click-through feedback with configurable weights; - incident-bot quicklinks API now calls RunbookScorer and returns the top N runbooks with score metadata; - added caching layer (memcached backed) for score windows with 1m TTL to avoid recomputing for high-traffic incidents; - added telemetry: runbook_score_{value,component}, quicklinks_latency_ms, quicklinks_miss_cache_count; - added unit and integration tests for scoring heuristics and end-to-end quicklinks response; - console docs update: oncall runbook ranking and tuning guide; - migration: small background job to backfill 30-day incident frequency; - added feature flag feature_incident_quicklink_slo_weighted (off by default). Testing: unit tests for scorer heuristics; integration tests validating ordering against synthetic incident datasets; smoke tested on staging against real incident stream with feature flag enabled. Rollout plan: feature gated rollout on staging->canary->100%. Observability: dashboards added under incident-bot/quicklinks for score distribution and latency; alert if quicklinks_latency_ms p95 > 200ms. Checklist: - [x] Implementation of scoring engine - [x] Tests added - [x] Metrics and dashboards - [x] Docs and runbook for tuning - [x] Feature flag gating - [x] Migration/backfill job - [x] Final review and approval Related: ENG-4567 implements the core SLO metrics export required for scoring. SUP-9021 requested higher-priority runbooks for production outages. Impact: expected improvement in operator time-to-closure for high-impact incidents. No breaking API changes; feature remains behind a flag until rollout is complete.

Add caching and telemetry for quicklinks scoring path
Add unit tests for scoring heuristics and integration tests for ordering
Backfill job for 30d incident frequency and migration script

Address review comments: add latency guard, reduce cache key cardinality
Fix flake in integration test and update CI matrix

incident-bot/service/quicklinks_handler.py - modified: call scorer and return score metadata
incident-bot/cache/memcache_client.py - new: thin wrapper for caching scores
review_thread: Ben Cho requested clearer unit tests around weight edge-cases and asked to add a safety clamp to avoid runaway scores; author replied: added tests and clamp in scoring function
Marisol Vega requested telemetry names be consistent with existing naming conventions and requested an alert threshold; author replied: updated telemetry keys and added p95 alert in dashboard config

Ethan Park raised concern about cache key cardinality leading to memcached hotkeys when incidents are very high-cardinality; author replied: reduced score inputs used for key derivation and added TTL guard
Ben Cho approved after author added latency guard that falls back to keyword ranking when scorer latency exceeds 150ms
Marisol Vega approved after dashboard updates
Automation: CI initially failed on integration matrix for older Python minor version; author fixed test compatibility and re-ran CI
release_notes: Incident-bot: Added SLO-weighted runbook quicklink ranking (feature-flagged) to prioritize high-impact runbooks and diagnostics. Includes telemetry and dashboards for tuning.
additional_notes: Performance guard: scorer falls back to existing keyword ranking if scoring exceeds 150ms to maintain on-call latency SLOs. Feature flag off by default; enable gradually. Migration job should be scheduled during low-traffic windows; backfill does not block rollout.
